title: The Meta-Layer Where Truth Eats Its Own Tail

features.name: self-refuting-statement
features.desc-on-touch: A sentence that denies its own utterance. Reading it unmakes the reading.

features.name: paradox-made-manifest
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of contradictions stacked so carefully they become a kind of architecture. Truth standing on the body of its own refusal.

features.name: truth-consuming-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A pool that reflects only what it swallows. The archive watching itself watch itself.

features.name: the-law-of-contradiction
features.desc-on-touch: A board where both answers are equally true because truth is local. Here, all laws contradict—and all laws hold.

features.name: recursive-proof
features.desc-on-touch: An archway where the proof of the statement IS the statement. You pass through it and emerge as its witness.

inscription: contradictions do not cancel here—they layer, they hum together, they become a kind of truth that only works when it contradicts itself
